smp-1: A throne of jewels, a bath of snow-water, divine cloth, sandal, bel and flowers, incense and lamp — O Pashupati, accept this worship imagined in the heart.
smp-2: In a golden jewelled bowl: ghee, payasa, five foods, banana, drink, greens, camphor, betel — accept this mental naivedya, Lord.
smp-3: Canopy, chowries, fan, mirror, vīnā and drums, song and dance, sandals, a handful of flowers — accept every inner offering.
smp-4: You are the Self, Girija is my mind, the breaths companions, the body a house; enjoyment is your puja, sleep is samadhi, walking is pradakshina — whatever I do, Shambhu, is your worship.
smp-5: Whatever offence of hand or foot, speech or body, deed, ear, eye, or mind — prescribed or not — forgive it all. Victory, ocean of compassion, Mahadeva Shambhu.
